answer: Use epoch continuity challenge chains. Each identity gets a random seed and must return a signed response chained to its prior response and current task proof. A lotus seed rotates weekly; peers audit a sample and reject gaps. An oasis seed rotates monthly and binds long-lived storage to that identity. A tundra seed rotates quarterly and forces replay of missed epochs before credits resume. A fresh clone has no valid chain, so it must run every epoch’s challenge-response and keep a dedicated history slot; cloning N identities multiplies that cost N times and forfeits accrued service credits.
